rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying something happened recently or has been true of late.

example.english: I haven't been getting enough sleep lately.
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 fan3 m4 gau3

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression for a recent stretch of time, especially with ongoing situations or repeated events.

example.english: Work has been really busy lately.
example.jyutping: gan6 paai4 faan1 gung1 hou2 mong4

rows.note: Use this for “these days” when the recent period is understood as the speaker's current situation.

example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 ngo5 dou1 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2
